description: Every attachment matching a Gmail query, downloaded to a folder in ONE call, with a manifest. Use it for a month of invoices ('has:attachment after:2026/08/01 before:2026/09/01') instead of walking threads and calling get_attachment per file. Do NOT use Gmail's own 'download all attachments' zip as an alternative: it is keyed by thread id and silently omits parts keyed by message id. Returns counts (threadsMatched, attachmentsFound, savedCount) so the harvest can be reconciled against Gmail's own has:attachment count, each saved file with its size and sha256, plus a per-file failure list. Files are named <message id>-<filename>; two of one name both survive. A client that asks for progress hears each attachment saved, out of how many; cancelling stops the harvest, which then ends as cancelled.

account.description: Which registered mailbox: a label from list_accounts; empty means the default account.

extensions.description: Filter by extension, e.g. ['.pdf','.xml']. Empty means every attachment.

max_attachments.description: Hard cap on files written. `truncated: true` in the result means you hit it.

max_threads.description: Threads scanned. Page with the query.

query.description: Gmail query syntax. Narrow it with a date window.

save_dir.description: A folder INSIDE the account's attachments folder (e.g. "2026-09/invoices"); empty for the folder itself. Copy files from the result's path to where they belong.

name: harvest_attachments
title: Harvest attachments for a query
